bar.note: No bar_index and no symbol. Use bar['close'], not bar.close.

closing.note: No FIFO, no 'close oldest', no implicit close. A close without a valid ticket is rejected as an event, not raised.

drawings.note: Descriptive only - never affects orders, fills, P&L or chronology. Malformed drawings fail the run.
drawings.time_rule: any 'time' must be an already-seen bar timestamp (no future bars)
drawings.type: optional list under the 'drawings' key of the on_bar dict return

error_codes.runtime: engine/config/data/run codes are raised by observa.run itself; read them from exc.code (see docs/STRATEGY_API.md)

examples.note: Imitate the gold example: entry with sl and reason, exact-ticket close, one annotation, output= persistence.

engine_owns: balance, equity, drawdown and all metrics
strategy_owns: intent only: direction, size, protective levels, reason

forbidden_patterns: Your own fill model, matching engine or backtest loop.
Applying spread, slippage or commission yourself.
Computing balance, equity, P&L, drawdown or any metric yourself.
Recreating order execution, queueing or SL/TP evaluation.
Reading future bars or indexing beyond the current bar.
Returning a bare signal dict or None from on_bar.
Using quantity/stop_loss/take_profit as SIGNAL input keys.

history.note: No lookahead is possible. Guard warm-up yourself: if len(history) < period: return []. It is all prior bars, not a fixed window, so slice history[-period:].

installation.forbidden_reason: The PyPI distribution named 'observa' is unrelated.

call_order: initialize(params) once before the first bar
on_bar(bar, portfolio, history) once per closed bar
teardown() once after the last bar
notes: A plain class with the three methods works; subclassing is optional.
TRAP: if you subclass observa.Strategy you must still override on_bar - the base class returns [] and a missing override silently produces a zero-trade run.
initialize receives the resolved params dict ({} when none are set).
Raising from any callback fails the run (code STRATEGY_ERROR).

invalid_returns: TRAP: a bare signal dict {'direction': 'buy', 'size': 1.0} - the engine reads only the 'signals' key, so it is ignored. Wrap it in a list.
TRAP: None - return [] for 'no action'; None is ambiguous.
str, tuple, number - anything not a list or dict.
on_bar.rule: Always return a list, or a dict containing a 'signals' list.

orders.note: Rejections (bad size, bad SL/TP distance, insufficient margin) are canonical order_rejected EVENTS, not Python exceptions.

keys.position_id: str, the exact ticket to close with

position.note: TRAP: signal INPUT uses lowercase 'buy' and keys size/sl/tp; position OUTPUT uses 'Buy' and stop_loss/take_profit. quantity is an output alias only - the input key is size.

reason.note: Recorded on the canonical strategy_decision event; visible in replay and via inspect_run/MCP. Over-long reasons fail the whole run.

fields.ticket: str, REQUIRED for close - use position['position_id']

signals.type: list of dicts returned from on_bar
signals.unknown_fields: TRAP: only those eight keys are read. Any other key (stop_loss, take_profit, quantity, qty, sl_price) is silently ignored, so a typo silently drops your stop loss. validate-strategy reports SIGNAL_FIELD_UNKNOWN.

does_not_prove: margin, SL/TP distance, or quantity validity (engine order_rejected events)
that any signal will ever be produced - zero signals in six bars is valid

security.tier_a: parses source only; does not import or execute the strategy
security.tier_b: IMPORTS the strategy module - top-level Python code may execute
security.tier_c: EXECUTES on_bar() through the real Observa Engine
security.warning: validate-strategy is not a sandbox. Tier B imports the strategy module, which may execute top-level Python code. Tier C additionally executes the strategy's on_bar() through the real Observa Engine. Only validate strategy code you trust.

tiers.A: structural: parses, lifecycle methods visible in the AST; never executes user code
tiers.B: imported: class resolves, signatures compatible, on_bar genuinely overridden; never calls on_bar
tiers.C: smoke: real Engine over 6 bundled bars, validating the RAW on_bar return; shape/integration only
